source_policy: 源内功方向与梅每点2.5%保留；2026官网71334正文明确剑对怪每点0.6%、格斗对怪最终额外1%。基础值、具体作用基数/时序及其余比例为项目采用；不冒充未知官方完整公式。
source_classification: monster-only update requires explicit target combat_kind=monster; martial NPC/player-character archetype is not monster simply because PvE. Existing old7beasts must be tagged monster by adopted definition. Missing combat_kind rejects formal encounter config, not default beast.

sword_monster_skill_power.scope: flat skill-power component only, not whole attack+weapon

fighter_noncombo_power.scope: explicit combo_skill=false martial attack; combo_skill=true or missing never guessed by skill name/hit count

application: only root attack_martial_skill, not normal basic/gather/heal/cost/DoT/reflection/derived extra. Use source class learned allocated positive effective grade. Passive effect eligibility is target-specific; group skill may hit monsters and martialNPCs with different applicable sword/fighter final modifiers.
skill_power_order: declared base flat power per hit -> add own eligible flat passive bonus plus explicitly registered real-enhancement, synthesis, jade, evolution, temporary-enhancement-boost, awakening and attribute-stone martial-flat weapon contributions once -> sum eligible same-scope skill-power percentage gains including explicitly registered jewelry martial_power_bonus_bp once, multiply/floor flat component -> add action attack draw and apply phase coefficient -> crit/hit-time modifiers -> ordinary mitigation. Never multiply weapon/attack twice; explicit flat additions may make flat0 positive. Enhancement/synthesis owners must be valid, no contribution inferred from display names.
fighter_final_order: after ordinary defense/flat reduction, before percentage protections/shields, floor(final_stage_incoming*(10000+100*effective_grade)/10000) once on eligible monster/noncombo root hit; no reapplication to derived damage
snapshots: grade and base skill-power taken at accepted action, target combat_kind at accepted primary/actual hit identity validated; no retarget to change paid snapshot. Hit-stage target-specific eligibility recorded on damage receipt; anti debuff later affects new actions, no refund or re-charge.
configuration: explicit named stacking/order graph and checked integer math required; conflicting group/multi-hit flags or absent flat power/combat kind reject. Negative/overflow not truncated as0.
persistence: store required action source snapshots and per-target modifier receipt, not mutable permanent base power. Save/replay never applies a second percentage or final-extra stage.
